capabilities: Schedule a request to a chosen Claudian chat tab for a set time
Automatically switch to the target tab and wait if it is busy
Manage pending tasks and view success/failure send history
Catch up on missed tasks after Obsidian restarts
disambiguation: Not a standalone task scheduler or Claude client; it only sends messages through the Claudian plugin's existing chat tabs.
extras: README is in Chinese. Obsidian must stay running; tasks that come due while it is closed are sent on next launch. Installed via BRAT or manually from releases; not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 本插件依赖 Claudian 插件提供的多对话框（tab）能力，需先在 Obsidian 中安装并启用 Claudian
motivation: The author built it because off-peak hours are outside work hours, so small developers cannot manually send requests then and lose the 50-75% cost savings.
problem: DeepSeek's off-peak pricing window (00:30-08:30 Beijing time) falls outside working hours, so someone would have to be at the computer to send requests and get the lower rate.

relations.evidence: 本插件依赖 Claudian 插件提供的多对话框（tab）能力

summary: Scheduler that sends queued requests to Claudian chat tabs during DeepSeek's off-peak pricing window to cut API costs.
